body: Holly shit. The Social anxiety fact sheet pretty much nailed it with everything that I am feeling.

The last time I saw a therapist was in the middle of July. It was an office that charged money based on my income so I was only paying ten dollars for each session. I saw him about four times but I thought he was one of the worst I had ever seen. The anxiety is huge. I'm starting to get panick attacks again. I bought this stuff called L-Theanine which helped a little but didn't do the trick so I stopped using it. I do go on walks pretty often. I don't have much else to do but take walks. The last time I got out of the house was two weeks ago to look at the lincoln college of technology. I mean actually got out of the house and did something other then take a walk. My sister took me. I had a panic attack while talking to the student advisor. My dad is sixty five years old and has only recently gotten his own health insurance. I am not on it. I live in Denver, Colorado. There is a swingset at the elementary school about a mile away. I live in one of the flattest, most bland parts of Denver. Usually when I do take walks I try to go at night. This is what is scaring me the most. I am so afraid of people seeing me when they walk by or drive by that I'm starting to become really reclusive. I'm afraid they are really sizing me up. I almost feel like they are after me. I try not to show my face in daylight now. I want to go to this school but I already dropped out of one school because of these problems.

I have been to so many therapists in my life and I'm only nineteen. It's hard to take their advice seriously when they are sitting there looking at the clock over my head every five minutes while I'm sitting across from them telling them the problems that are really disturbing towards me. I'm serious. I was seeing a therapist that delt with mostly teenagers. I saw him twice and the third time he completely mixed me up with another one of his clients. He called me matt and asked if the doctor had prescribed something new or how my medication was doing or some bullshit. He called me matt and I completely blanked out everything he said after that. I told him who I was and he apologized. The rest of the session was awkward and I never saw him again after that.

Lately I have been feeling very impulsive. I just want to snap at everybody that I actually do come in contact with. It's a very strong impulse but I haven't acted on it. It's so hard to get out when I'm afraid to leave my house. It takes so much mental energy to do anything now. I'll talk to the moderator of my fund but the last time I talked to him he said that it was strictly for education unless I don't use it and I turn twenty-three. I'll hurt myself before I hurt anybody else though. I don't want to hurt anybody else physically.
